I am Kai, and I work mornings at a coffee shop, so I am usually home by three. I enjoy hiking on weekends and cooking simple dinners.

I like a clean kitchen, so I wash my dishes right away and I am happy to take turns with the bathroom and trash. I keep quiet hours after ten and I use headphones for music. If I have friends over, I will ask first.

I am excited to meet you all. Thanks!

Kai
